The '''Ferelakk Savannah''' was a massive savannah located in [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine's]] southern hemisphere. It was more heavily populated than the [[Derelkoos Desert]] but was of lesser cultural importance. The people of the savannah lived in villages of up to 5,000 and farmed [[voraxx]] and [[bracil]].<ref name="LoNH" />
